name: ai_message
description: Private text and feedback history for a learner-owned AI tutor session; recordings are never stored

user_id.description: Buildy account id of the learner who owns the message

audio_url.description: Always empty in this demo; no audio is uploaded or retained

transcript.description: Confirmed editable browser transcript, if supplied by the learner

feedback_json.description: Tutor feedback, practice items, corrections, or mastery details serialized as JSON

skill.description: Verified session skill associated with this message

topic.description: Verified session topic associated with this message
